Describe the work you want in your own words. See what the job involves, what it pays where you live, and how many openings are expected.

Loading California occupation data…

Where this information comes from. Job descriptions, tasks, knowledge, skills, preparation levels, and job titles come from the O*NET database (O*NET 31.0 Database, August 2026 release). Pay comes from the California Employment Development Department (EDD) Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (2026 release (1st Qtr)). Job outlook, typical entry-level education, experience, and on-the-job training come from EDD's Long-Term Occupational Employment Projections (2024-2034 for California; 2023-2033 for areas).

About county areas. EDD does not publish pay or projections for individual counties. It publishes them for metropolitan areas and regions. This tool shows the EDD area that includes the county you choose, and it names that area so you know which counties it covers.
